result.summary: Found 2 issues: the selected category filter does not match the restaurants shown, and some secondary text appears low-contrast.

issues.description: The Pizza category chip is selected, but Fastest near you and Popular right now show non-pizza places (poké, burgers, pasta/trattoria, ramen).
issues.suggestion: Filter all restaurant sections by the selected category, or reset the chip to All if those sections are meant to stay unfiltered.

issues.description: Search placeholder text and muted labels (DELIVER TO, delivery fee lines under cards) look low-contrast on their light backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken placeholder and secondary text so contrast meets at least WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text).
